title.narrative: Regional Sustainable Energy Industry Development Project

description.narrative: The project development objective (PDO) is to increase the data availability and capacity of power utilities of the Pacific IslandCountries and Papua New Guinea (PNG) to enhance their ability to incorporate and manage renewable energy technologies and long-termdisaster risk planning.

title.narrative: Improved technical and institutional capacity of PPA and power utilities
Increased planning capacity for disaster recovery and risk reduction
PPA publishing reports on grievance redress mechanism and how issues were resolved
Increased available planning tools and training to both PPA and utilities in the use of these tools
Increased public information on RE resources and variability
Phase 1 (satellite based) resource mapping assessment of solar and/or wind capacity across 10 PICs completed and available
Phase 2 (ground measurements) resource mapping assessment of solar and/or wind capacity across 10 PICs completed and available
Phase 3 (validation) resource mapping assessment of solar and/or wind capacity across 10 PICs completed and available
Post-disaster and/or disaster-risk reduction needs assessment developed
Reports on industry guidelines and competency standards available through PPA
